id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Oh... This village is wrapped in gloom too...
"Well, I'll take my leave here. Thanks for everything.
"That man traveled so far alone. There must be a reason, perhaps tied to the village's grim mood.
"Hee hee... In that case, it's the Parade of Smiles' time to shine!
"First let's find out what's happening in this village! Let's make everyone smile!
"That Sylvando... something about him nags at me. As if I met him long ago..."
